root_causes.cause: Index rebuild released its lease in finally BEFORE the final index option write, without identifying generation. An older/expired generation could remove a newer owner's lease and overwrite or publish stale completion.
root_causes.correction: Keep owned lease through final write, require matching unexpired generation and its still-running projection before commit; release only when generation matches; return bounded index_generation_superseded error on observed takeover. Recheck stale lock before reclaim.
root_causes.limitation: WordPress read/delete operations are non-atomic without a compare-and-swap/conditional SQL strategy. The new regression validates deterministic overlapping ownership scenarios but not a truly simultaneous multi-process race.

root_causes.cause: Accepted index provider source_versions previously normalized by silently dropping invalid owner/version entries, then published a successful partial manifest.
root_causes.correction: Compare validated owner/version entry count with original; reject entire builder response upon malformed entries, yielding a safe failed state.
